standard.summary: PiSSA 导出模式 可选值（含换档影响）。
standard.effect: 枚举切换会改变算法或资源行为。
standard.avoidWhen: 未理解影响前不要叠多个激进档。

optionDescriptions.LoRA无损兼容导出: 尽量无损收成能挂原底的 LoRA。
optionDescriptions.LoRA快速近似导出: 近似快收，精度可能差一点。

standard_en.summary: The PiSSA export mode; the values below include what changing gear does.
standard_en.effect: Switching the enum changes algorithm or resource behaviour.
standard_en.whenToUse: Prefer the default and switch only after a short test.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not stack several aggressive gears before you understand the effect.

optionDescriptions.LoRA无损兼容导出: Closes out as losslessly as it can into a LoRA that can hang on the original base.
optionDescriptions.LoRA快速近似导出: An approximate, quick close-out; the accuracy may be a little worse.
